propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit commit via git-blame over the pre-fix state (fixing-commit~1), resolving the culprit commit to a ticket via its rebar-ticket: trailer, only when a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines across file_impact point to one commit.
The --caused-by <id> parameter on rebar transition allows explicit override or specification of the caused_by link at close time, threaded through transition.py, transition_compute, and close_ticket.

The auto-derived or explicit caused_by link is written via graph._links._write_link_event directly, bypassing the closed-source guard that rejects links from closed sources, enabling the link to be created after the bug is closed.
No caused_by link is created if file_impact is missing, no fixing commit is found, no dominant (>50%) commit exists, or the dominant commit carries no resolvable rebar-ticket: trailer.
The public library facade transition() in src/rebar/_lib_writes.py must accept and thread a caused_by parameter to enable library callers (not just CLI) to set caused_by on close.
